title: Codwiz
description: A mod all about cods and Codwiz!
body:
Welcome to Codwiz the Wizard.;]

Cod smell bad and they also do a really crazy thing where they get hats and they chuck them at people who want to eat them and they put them in a firepit; that's what they always do. That's it.
"Why don't villagers want cod?" said literally everyone, so we fixed it, and now they do.

Only use the explosive sword with full netherite armor with blast protector 5.

We have genetically modified all the fish to have 17 vigintilion hit points.

Have you ever thought that it was not possible to make a ship out of cod? Well, in this mod, we've genetically engineered a pretty cool cod ship. "Whoa, that's my texture!" -Codwiz Developer. Yes,it IS your texture!

Cause who cares about the letter 'e'?
The Not Cod is a lie. IT'S DEEP IN THE OCEAN.

#CodwizForever
No Cods Were Hurt While Codding This Mod.
"so long, and thanks for all the fish!"
- Douglas Adams, (Hitchhiker's Guide to The Galaxy)
